PlayerRecipes.Name: Allow Players to view crafting recipe list
PlayerRecipes.Hint:
If enabled, players can access the Crafting Recipes window at anytime and view all crafting recipes in the system.  If disabled, the Crafting window search bar will be hidden when showing Relevant Recipes. 
 Recommended - Enabled

ShowRelevantRecipes.Name: Show Relevant Recipes Button
ShowRelevantRecipes.Hint:
If enabled, a 'Show Relevant Recipes' button will be included in the component list after clicking 'Share All Components' in the harvesting window. 
 Recommended - Enabled

PlayerCrafting.Name: Allow Players to Craft Items
PlayerCrafting.Hint:
If enabled, players can use the Crafting Recipes window to send items to their inventory. 
 Recommended - Disabled
PlayerCrafting.Denied: You do not have permission to craft items.

PlayerHarvesting.Name: Allow Players to access Harvesting
PlayerHarvesting.Hint:
If enabled, players can access the Harvest Creature - Harvest Controls window. 
 Recommended - Disabled

HeldComponents.HeldComponentsHint:
If enabled, an extra column will be added to the crafting window recipe table to display a breakdown of who is holding the required components.  This also adds a button to toggle filtering held components. 
 Recommended - Client specific, may result in the table loading slower
HeldComponents.PartyInventorySupportHint:
If enabled, items within the Party-Inventory module will be included in the Held Components column. 
Requires Display Held Components to be enabled.
Requires https://github.com/teroparvinen/foundry-party-inventory
